Name: Sunnie's Spirit and Rain Horses
Author: VaqueroMarston
Description:
Changes your horse to look like Spirit or Rain. Also includes 18 saddle colours! Generic Mod Config Menu compatible.
This is my first mod because I couldn't find what I wanted, so I made it myself! Please let me know if you run into any bugs.

[b]- HOW TO INSTALL -[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract Content Patcher into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder and install SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=2]Input this text into your Steam launch options (Library > Stardew Valley > Properties):[/size]
[/list]"c:\program files (x86)\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\StardewModdingAPI.exe" %command%
[list]
[*][size=2]Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI to create a config.json file, then close again.[/size]
[*]Extract Spirit and Rain Horses into your Mods folder
[*]Enjoy your new horses! :3
[/list]
[size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended but not required.
[/size]
[size=4][b]To change which horse skin you are using without GMCM:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract Spirit and Rain Horses into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=2]Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI to create a config.json file, then close[/size]
[*][size=2]Open the config.json file using Notepad or a similar app and use it to input the name of the skin and saddle colour you want. Input "false" to disable. If the config.json will not generate, rename the example_config.json to config and use that[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy your new horses :3[/size]
[/list]
